protected_identity: Attacking produces temporary three-red combat mana after a respondable firebending trigger.
Artifact and Ally spells receive flash permission while commander is present.
Ally/firebending interactions and tactical in-combat artifact casting should remain material, not merely ornamental.

leading_challenger.why: Potential top-library access to all spell types via flash-cast artifact, contingent on sorcery-speed reconfigure and adequate creature/blue mana; competing baseline engines and theme cost require targeted testing.

secondary_challenger.why: Alternative artifact finisher under interaction; not a verified better identity-preserving replacement.

rules_observations: Firebending is a triggered ability on stack; mana expires after combat.
Mai's flash permission grants timing only for artifact/Ally spells, not sorcery-speed reconfigure or station abilities.
Roaming Throne must preexist the attacking trigger to double it; later flash casting is nonretroactive.
Basalt Monolith and Rings of Brighthearth have a payable colorless loop requiring initial copy mana and interleaved taps, not colored mana.
Tundra Tank indestructible does not answer exile, bounce or sacrifice.
Firebender Ascension quest-copy payoff is threshold-dependent, not an unconditional initial attack doubler.
